_comment: Verifier policy for the PKI-in-DID demonstration. Every rule the brief and the source document require is a setting here, never hardcoded.
_trust_anchors_note: The National Root CA is the ONLY credential trust anchor. The Web-TLS root lives in a separate store and is never consulted for credential validation.
_chain_note: Brief verifier rule 2 -- reject a credential whose JWK has no x5c -- is not a setting, because it is the premise of the whole exercise rather than a choice: with no chain there is nothing to validate against the National Root CA, and chain.load_chain rejects with x5c_missing. What IS a choice is whether a chain held by reference will do: allow_x5u false refuses x5u, which is what keeps verification possible with no network.
_require_spki_jwk_binding_note: Source document tab C: without this check the certificate chain is decorative.
_require_issuer_authorization_note: Source document tab C verifier step 5: a valid chain proves who certified the key, not what it may issue.
_revocation_note: Brief verifier rule 3: reject if the revocation status is unknown or expired. Cached data is honoured only while inside its own nextUpdate, which is what creates the CRL revocation window.
